description: In crates/core/src/group_log/types.rs, LogEntry::operator_signature is Vec<u8>. Ed25519 signatures are always exactly 64 bytes. Using Vec<u8> loses the static size guarantee, allocates on the heap per entry, and requires runtime length checks downstream. Change to [u8; 64] or introduce a newtype Ed25519Signature([u8; 64]) that derives the needed traits. Downstream construction sites will need updating.
notes: Pre-existing: operator_signature Vec<u8> predates this PR. Deferring.
title: LogEntry.operator_signature should be [u8;64] not Vec<u8>
